listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask / Zelda64 Recompiled [Android] (linkzenic)
listing.summary: Explore The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask / Zelda64 Recompiled [Android] (linkzenic) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Choose the Android App APK from this fork, not its separate Android randomizer-mod ZIP, and install it on an ARM64 Android device with a working Vulkan driver. Open the app and choose your own supported Majora’s Mask ROM when asked; it contains no game assets. Grant the requested storage access for its /sdcard/Zelda64 profile.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Back up /sdcard/Zelda64, including saves, config and mods, before replacing or removing this beta app. Install mods through its own Mods menu. Native-code mods require Android ARM64 .so libraries; desktop Linux, Windows or macOS plugins cannot substitute for them. This beta APK is debug-signed, so keep data safe before a future signing change. Its profile and updates remain upstream-owned and outside Portcove runtime backup/rollback.
